title: Home practical guide and safety card: string telephone
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: Sound (Misty Mountain, Sierra and How Can We Change a Sound?)
source: Written for science/y4 lesson 15 (Home practical guide and safety card: string telephone (portal worksheet; adult makes the holes))
intro: Lesson 15: Sound travels through solids, liquids and gases. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To show that sound travels through a solid (string)
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: An adult makes a small hole in the bottom of each cup
Thread the string through and tie each end to a paper clip inside the cup
Stand apart so the string is tight
One person speaks quietly into a cup; the other listens
Try again with the string loose
Record what you hear each time

head: String
Could I hear? (well, a little, not at all)

questions.q: Big question: why can't astronauts hear each other in space?
questions.a: Space is a vacuum with no particles to carry the vibrations.
